title: setDesiredAPY commit branch does not clear pendingAPYBps / pendingAPYBlockNumber, leaving inert-but-misleading view state

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-1 'Two-step APY setting process (intentional security feature)'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-1 covers the existence of the two-step gate, not the post-commit state-hygiene defect. The pending* slots stay populated with the just-committed values, so getPendingAPYInfo() lies until the next preview overwrites. Distinct QA defect.
